methods.name: check_shortcut
methods.summary: Check for a shortcut answer that bypasses CalcStack push and caching. Called in `get_idx` before pushing to the CalcStack. If this returns `Some`, the answer is returned directly without pushing, solving, or caching.

methods.name: create_recursive
methods.summary: We have reached a recursive solve of this binding. Create a sentinel value to store information about it.

methods.name: promote_recursive
methods.summary: We hit a recursive case, so promote the recursive value into an answer that needs to be sufficient for now.

methods.name: record_recursive
methods.signature: fn record_recursive(_answers: &AnswersSolver<'_, '_, Ans>, answer: Self::Answer, _recursive: Var) -> Self::Answer
methods.summary: We solved a binding, but during its execution we gave some people back a recursive value. Record that recursive value along with the answer.

methods.name: solve
methods.signature: fn solve(answers: &AnswersSolver<'_, '_, Ans>, binding: &Self::Value, range: TextRange, errors: &ErrorCollector) -> SolveResult<Self>
methods.summary: Solve the binding. Note that the key (`Self`) is not provided, as the result of a binding should not depend on the key it was bound to.
